name: brief
description: Product setup before any code exists: state the product in one claim and state its refusals, test it against unlike uses so that no capability enters for a single case, turn it into a numbered proof a stranger can run, order the slices so the first one carries a consumer end to end, and lay the entry point, product document, decision records and invariant registry every later decision is read from.

interface.shortDescription: Product setup before the first line of code
interface.longDescription: The phase that ends before any code exists: a concept stated as one claim with the refusals that bound it, tested against unlike uses so that a capability enters the product only when two of them require it, turned into a numbered proof a stranger can run, and ordered into slices whose first one carries a consumer end to end. It leaves behind the four documents every later decision is read from — one entry point, the normative product document, decision records with their rejected alternatives, and an invariant registry — with the authority order between them fixed. It tracks no work and lands no change; the delivery method takes the first slice from here.
defaultPrompt: Use $brief:brief to state this product and its refusals, order the slices that reach it, and lay the documents the rest of the project is read from.
